descriptor: Hand-finished steel, brass and oak furniture

voice.summary: Sounds like a maker describing the weld seam: sparse, confident and rooted in material. It names the metal, the finish and the run size, and leaves the shine to the page.
dos: Name materials and finishes exactly, such as brass or oak
State small batch sizes as fact
donts: Do not use luxury cliches like bespoke excellence
Do not rush the reader with urgency

taglines: Forged to last. Shaped to feel.
Steel, brass and oak, by hand
Twelve at a time, never more
Made to order, built to outlive trends
Finishes that gain character with age
boilerplate: Alloy & Oak is a small metalworks studio that hand-finishes steel, brass and oak furniture to order in limited runs of twelve, with chrome, gold and copper finishes.

microcopy.success: Added to your order. We'll confirm the finish.
microcopy.error: We couldn't add that piece. Please try again.

logo.note: A faceted diamond shape suggests cut metal and hard craft, and stays crisp in capitals.
